name: OPTIMUM
summary: The losses had been in the trillions, and so an agreement had been made. One name from each of the warring civilizations would compete for the seed of life granting the right to grow the next scale of the universe’s fractal plane molded in the image of its champion. In this contest of deities & fiends, an ancient fallen foe, the shapeshifter of endless names, set aim on claiming & destroying the seed, to reset time & space for without a new scale all existence will collapse into a big bang.
